title.zh: Binance backs Zilliqa EVM migration as legacy ZIL network is retired - Cryptonews.net
title.en: Binance backs Zilliqa EVM migration as legacy ZIL network is retired - Cryptonews.net

current_state.zh: Binance is supporting Zilliqa's migration to an EVM-compatible network as the project retires its legacy ZIL chain, a transition requiring holders and integrators to move assets and tooling to the new environment.
current_state.en: Binance is supporting Zilliqa's migration to an EVM-compatible network as the project retires its legacy ZIL chain, a transition requiring holders and integrators to move assets and tooling to the new environment.
